title: When to play a provisional ball
question: If you hit a shot towards the trees and think your ball might be lost or out of bounds, what should you do before walking forward to look for it?

choices.text: Play a provisional ball and clearly announce it to your group.
Go search for your first ball immediately.
Drop a ball in the area where you think your ball landed.
Wait for your friends to suggest what to do.

explanation: If you think your ball may be lost or out of bounds, you should play a provisional ball from the place where you played your last shot and make it clear to your group that it is a provisional before you go to look for your original ball.
